description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllGnFalseSurnd]{Kasumi Juusha no Jutsu}.

You perceive an altered version of your immediate surroundings. The illusion may show: a closed door where an opening is, a friendly figure where a hostile one stands, a stable floor where a pit yawns, etc. While this effect persists you have a -2 status penalty to Perception checks that would expose the illusion (and likely act on false information).

You may attempt a new Will save to disbelieve when you interact with the illusion in a contradiction-revealing way (touching a 'wall' that isn't there, attacking 'someone' who is not where they appear, etc.).
